description: Plugin hooks for project-toolkit. Every registration routes through invoke_dispatch_claude.py (one process per (event, matcher) group, issue #3075); membership lives in dispatch_groups.json (plugin-* groups). Inside a checkout of the repo that publishes this plugin, the dispatcher exits immediately so hooks do not double-fire with .claude/settings.json.

Reinstall: /install-plugin rjmurillo/ai-agents" >&2; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -d "$_ptr" ]; then echo "$_warn Plugin root is not a directory: $_ptr. Reinstall: /install-plugin rjmurillo/ai-agents" >&2; exit 0; fi; _i=""; for _c in python3 python; do if command -v "$_c" >/dev/null 2>&1; then _ok=$("$_c" -I -c "import sys;print(int(sys.version_info>=(3,10)))" 2>/dev/null) || _ok=""; if [ "$_ok" = "1" ]; then _i="$_c"; break; fi; fi; done; if [ -z "$_i" ]; then echo "$_warn No suitable Python interpreter found (need >= 3.10). Install: https://www.python.org/downloads/" >&2; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -f "$_ptr/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py" ]; then echo "$_warn Dispatcher missing or not a file: $_ptr/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py. Reinstall: /install-plugin rjmurillo/ai-agents" >&2; exit 0; fi; "$_i" -I -u "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py" --group plugin-posttooluse-1-markdown_auto_lint; _rc=$?; if [ $_rc -eq 126 ] || [ $_rc -eq 127 ]; then echo "$_warn Python interpreter failed to start ($_i, exit $_rc).
